The piece in detail

Full description & specifications

About this piece

Formulated as a compact 100 g solid bar pairing ground turmeric rhizome with kojic acid for everyday sink and shower routines. Rather than relying on plastic pump bottles, the solid format rinses clean and travels without leaks.

Every detail published here follows OPAR's factual listing standard: listed weight, cleansing scope, and supplier source stay separate from marketing overclaims. Cosmetic safety documentation and full ordered INCI ingredient disclosure remain tracked in the verification accordion below prior to live fulfilment.

During construction preview, a dummy unit price and multi-bar sample option let you test cart totals, variant updates, and invoice checkout end to end.

Care & handling

Keep the bar on a slatted wooden or stone soap dish between washes so water drains freely. Rinse thoroughly with cool or lukewarm water and pat dry.

Common questions

Questions about this piece

Is £9.50 the final live selling price?

No. £9.50 is a construction-sample price used to test cart math and checkout invoices while final landed supplier costs and shipping margins are settled.

Does OPAR claim this bar treats acne or lightens skin?

No. Supplier marketing wording is excluded. This bar is described strictly as a 100 g turmeric and kojic-acid daily cleansing soap.

When is the ingredient list confirmed?

The complete ordered INCI ingredient list and destination dispatch terms are confirmed in writing on your invoice prior to payment.
